title: Checkout Process
description: Learn about the checkout process and how customers complete purchases on your Tijraa store.
content:
Checkout Process

The checkout process is the final step in the customer journey. This guide explains how the checkout works and how to optimize it for better conversion rates.

Checkout Steps

The checkout process includes:

  1. Cart Review: Review items in cart
  2. Shipping Information: Enter delivery address
  3. Shipping Method: Select shipping option
  4. Payment Information: Enter payment details
  5. Order Review: Review order summary
  6. Place Order: Complete purchase

Guest Checkout

Customers can checkout without account:

  • No account creation required
  • Faster checkout process
  • Enter email for order updates
  • Option to create account after purchase

Account Checkout

For logged-in customers:

  • Pre-filled information
  • Saved addresses
  • Order history access
  • Faster checkout

Shipping Information

Customers provide:

  • Full name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Billing address
  • Shipping address
  • Same as billing option

Shipping Method Selection

Customers choose:

  • Available shipping methods
  • Delivery options
  • Shipping costs
  • Estimated delivery time

Payment Methods

Available payment options:

  • Credit/debit cards
  • PayPal
  • Other payment gateways
  • Bank transfer
  • Cryptocurrency

Options depend on configured gateways.

Order Summary

Before placing order, customers see:

  • Products ordered
  • Subtotal
  • Shipping cost
  • Tax (if applicable)
  • Discounts/coupons
  • Total amount

Coupon Codes

Customers can apply coupons:

  • Enter coupon code
  • Apply discount
  • See savings
  • Update totals

Order Confirmation

After placing order:

  • Order confirmation page
  • Order number
  • Confirmation email
  • Payment confirmation
  • Estimated delivery date

Optimizing Checkout

Improve conversion rates:

  • Keep checkout simple
  • Minimize required fields
  • Show progress indicator
  • Display trust badges
  • Offer multiple payment options
  • Show security indicators

Mobile Checkout

Optimize for mobile:

  • Responsive checkout design
  • Mobile-friendly forms
  • Quick payment options
  • Apple Pay / Google Pay

Checkout Security

Secure checkout process:

  • SSL/HTTPS encryption
  • PCI DSS compliance
  • Secure payment processing
  • Data protection

Troubleshooting Checkout

Common issues:

  • Payment Fails: Check gateway configuration
  • Shipping Not Showing: Verify shipping methods active
  • Coupon Not Working: Check coupon validity
  • Order Not Processing: Check payment gateway status

Next Steps

After checkout setup:

  • Process orders
  • Configure payment gateways
meta_description: Complete guide to the checkout process in Tijraa including guest checkout, payment methods, and checkout optimization.
